title: Smart RAG Chatbot
shortDescription: Document-grounded RAG chatbot that lets users upload files, retrieve relevant chunks, and ask questions answered by an LLM with citations from their own knowledge.
description: Smart RAG Chatbot is a retrieval-augmented generation assistant built to turn personal or operational documents into a searchable knowledge base. Users upload files; the system extracts text, chunks content, stores embeddings, retrieves the most relevant passages, and generates grounded answers through an LLM—bridging study notes, ops docs, and chat in one pipeline.

solution: Implemented a full RAG pipeline—upload → extract → chunk → store → retrieve → generate—with a chat UI for iterative Q&A over user documents, focusing on retrieval quality and grounded responses.

Built document upload and text extraction flows
Implemented chunking strategy and embedding/retrieval pipeline
Developed chat UI for question answering over retrieved context
Collaborated via Git on chatbot repository structure and iteration

Embedding-based retrieval for grounded LLM answers

results: Delivered a working knowledge assistant pattern that answers questions from user-uploaded documents—demonstrating practical RAG engineering beyond FAQ chatbots.
architecture: Ingestion service extracts and chunks uploaded documents; embeddings are stored for similarity search; at query time relevant chunks are retrieved and passed as context to an LLM for grounded answer generation in a chat interface.

LLM answers grounded in retrieved context
Iterative chat over a personal document corpus
